design.full_denominator: all indexed tasks are scheduled in every trial and arm
design.nested_membership: distractors are stable-hash prefixes within each task and trial
design.presentation_order: a separate stable hash avoids curated-first ordering bias
design.reference_bundle: the upstream curated task bundle remains present in every arm
design.repeat_pairing: all arms for one task and trial share task, verifier, and trial seed

evidence_contract.headline_blocker: attach a separately estimated empirical oracle manifest and complete actual-invocation traces
